limitations: Prequalified Undici subset; not a representative sample of arbitrary repository changes.
Thirty tasks and twenty source groups; repeated trials are correlated and do not establish a five-percent task-loss bound.
Recent source dates do not prove absence from model training; provider IDs do not identify immutable served weights.
Bypass rows are independent strong-only samples; their differences do not establish multi-model cooperation.
Costs use recorded provider usage and frozen tariffs, not a separately reconciled invoice; infrastructure and engineering excluded.
Original live arm time includes public verification and excludes final private grading; replay time is never substituted.
Batch one allowed only exact EventSource warning PID substitutions after full-request comparison.
Batch five had two earlier unlocalized strict replay mismatches; a complete instrumented audit later matched with zero substitutions. Original failures remain unexplained.
The public artifact reproduces statistical analysis; private model responses and test fixtures are not included.
No production deployment or default activation.
